roadmap.title: New Light onboarding and basic activities
roadmap.description: Create the three classes, finish their Light-subclass onboarding, complete Light Reforged, and use repeatable public events for the early achievements.

roadmap.title: Weekly systems, Xûr, and Gambit
roadmap.description: Reach Weekly Rewards Rank 20 within one reset, visit Xûr during his Friday-to-Tuesday window, and win a Gambit match.

roadmap.title: Long-term collections and Triumphs
roadmap.description: Build the Exotic collections, claim 5,000 Triumph score, finish an attainable seal, and complete a compatible legacy Collections Badge.

roadmap.title: Master and Grandmaster Ops
roadmap.description: Prepare an endgame build and fireteam, then combine Master and Grandmaster Portal completions where possible and watch for the two eligible Darkness Falls activities.

roadmap.title: Dreaming City and Forsaken endgame
roadmap.description: Enter the Dreaming City, earn Wish-Ender, clear Shattered Throne, and finish Last Wish through Queenswalk.

achievements.summary: Create a Guardian and finish class selection plus character customization to trigger the legacy level achievement.

guide.context: The displayed level-20 requirement is a legacy description. New Guardians now receive credit when their initial character setup is complete.

steps.text: Select an empty character slot and choose Titan, Hunter, or Warlock.
Complete the Guardian's appearance and confirm the character to enter the opening sequence.
Wait for the achievement after character creation finishes; no level grind is required.

achievements.summary: Unlock and equip the Arc, Solar, and Void Light subclasses on one Titan after completing Ikora Rey's two missing-subclass quests.

guide.context: A new Titan begins with Arc. The legacy counter requires only the three original Light subclasses, so Stasis, Strand, and Prismatic are unnecessary.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{A Guardian Rises}, start @mechanic{A Spark of Hope}, and follow Commander Zavala's Tower objective to @npc{Ikora Rey}.

Accept @mechanic{Stoking the Flame} for Solar and @mechanic{Gazing Into the Abyss} for Void. In each quest, earn 1,000 points by defeating combatants—matching-element damage awards substantially more points—and generate 3 Orbs of Power.
Open the Titan subclass screen and equip Arc, Solar, and Void at least once each after both quests are complete.

achievements.summary: Unlock and equip the Solar, Arc, and Void Light subclasses on one Hunter after completing Ikora Rey's two missing-subclass quests.

guide.context: A new Hunter begins with Solar. The legacy counter requires only the three original Light subclasses, so Stasis, Strand, and Prismatic are unnecessary.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{A Guardian Rises}, start @mechanic{A Spark of Hope}, and follow Commander Zavala's Tower objective to @npc{Ikora Rey}.

Accept @mechanic{Riding the Storm} for Arc and @mechanic{Gazing Into the Abyss} for Void. In each quest, earn 1,000 points by defeating combatants—matching-element damage awards substantially more points—and generate 3 Orbs of Power.
Open the Hunter subclass screen and equip Solar, Arc, and Void at least once each after both quests are complete.

achievements.summary: Unlock and equip the Void, Arc, and Solar Light subclasses on one Warlock after completing Ikora Rey's two missing-subclass quests.

guide.context: A new Warlock begins with Void. The legacy counter requires only the three original Light subclasses, so Stasis, Strand, and Prismatic are unnecessary.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{A Guardian Rises}, start @mechanic{A Spark of Hope}, and follow Commander Zavala's Tower objective to @npc{Ikora Rey}.

Accept @mechanic{Riding the Storm} for Arc and @mechanic{Stoking the Flame} for Solar. In each quest, earn 1,000 points by defeating combatants—matching-element damage awards substantially more points—and generate 3 Orbs of Power.
Open the Warlock subclass screen and equip Void, Arc, and Solar at least once each after both quests are complete.

achievements.summary: Complete Lord Shaxx's @mechanic{Light Reforged} quest after finishing the New Light introduction through @mechanic{The Disgraced}.

guide.context: Light Reforged becomes available only after the onboarding route reaches The Disgraced strike and returns the Guardian to the Tower.

steps.text: Progress @mechanic{A Guardian Rises} through the complete @mechanic{The Disgraced} strike.
Return to @loc{the Tower}, speak to @npc{Lord Shaxx}, and accept the quest named @mechanic{Light Reforged}.
Complete every objective displayed in Light Reforged and turn in its final step to Lord Shaxx.

achievements.summary: Activate and successfully finish five Heroic Public Events, using repeated @mechanic{Glimmer Extraction} events if desired.

guide.context: Each successful Heroic completion advances the cumulative counter, so the five events may use the same event type and can be completed across different destinations.

steps.text: Open a destination map, select a Public Event icon for @mechanic{Glimmer Extraction}, and reach the event before it begins.
During each run, destroy one small Glimmer Refinery beside each of the three extraction sites, then defend the large Heroic Glimmer pile until its progress bar fills.
Finish five separate Glimmer Extraction events after their Heroic state activates; a normal completion does not advance this counter.

achievements.summary: Trigger @mechanic{Glimmer Extraction} as Heroic by destroying three Glimmer Refineries, then defend the Glimmer pile until completion.

guide.context: Public Events contain event-specific hidden triggers. The Heroic state must activate before the ordinary event objective finishes.

steps.text: Track a @mechanic{Glimmer Extraction} Public Event from a destination map and join it before the first extraction site is cleared.
Destroy the small Glimmer Refinery device beside each extraction site for three devices total; a missed device can appear again at the final site.
After the event changes to Heroic, stand near the large Glimmer pile and defend it until the capture bar reaches full.

achievements.description: Complete a Vanguard Ops activity on Master difficulty or higher.
achievements.summary: Finish one Master-or-higher activity from the Director Portal's @mechanic{Vanguard Ops} selection.

guide.context: Master Portal activities impose a large Power disadvantage. Completion credit is awarded at the activity result, not when the difficulty is selected.

steps.text: From the @loc{Director}, use the lower-screen @loc{Portal Ops} entry and choose an available @mechanic{Vanguard Ops} activity.
Choose @mechanic{Master} difficulty or a higher available tier and assemble a fireteam if matchmaking is unavailable.
Finish every objective and defeat the final boss so the Master-or-higher activity completion registers.

achievements.description: Collect 15 Red War exotic weapons or armor.
achievements.estTime: 20–80 hours depending on drops and legacy tracking
achievements.summary: Add 15 distinct Red War entries—weapon or armor—to Exotic Collections, then relaunch if the legacy counter is delayed.

guide.context: This legacy counter has awarded at varying total-Exotic counts for different accounts. Red War entries follow the displayed condition most directly, while delayed credit may appear after changing characters or restarting.

steps.text: Open @loc{Collections}, identify the Red War Exotic weapon and armor entries already registered, and count progress toward 15 distinct entries.
Acquire missing eligible Exotics through Exotic engrams, surviving Exotic quests, or purchases from @npc{Xûr} until at least 15 Red War entries are recorded.
If the achievement does not appear after the fifteenth Red War entry, continue adding distinct Exotics, wait for server credit, then change characters or restart Destiny 2.

achievements.description: Reach Weekly Rewards Rank 20 in the Seasonal Hub.
achievements.summary: Reach Rank 20 on the account-wide Weekly Reward Track in the @loc{Seasonal Hub} before the weekly reset.

guide.context: The Weekly Reward Track resets with the weekly cycle. Daily Objectives award one track rank and Weekly Objectives award four ranks under the current system.

steps.text: From the @loc{Director}, use the lower-screen @loc{Portal Ops} entry, open @loc{Seasonal Hub}, and view its Daily and Weekly Objectives.
Complete and claim Daily and Weekly Objectives until their awarded Weekly Reward Track progress reaches Rank 20.
Open the Weekly Reward Track and claim the Rank 20 reward before the next weekly reset.

achievements.description: Complete an Ops Activity on Master difficulty or higher.
achievements.summary: Complete any Ops activity in the Director's Portal on Master difficulty or higher.

guide.context: A Grandmaster Portal clear also satisfies this Master-or-higher condition, allowing the achievement to unlock alongside The Prestige.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Director}, enter the @loc{Portal}, and choose an available Solo, Fireteam, or Pinnacle Ops activity.
Set the activity to @mechanic{Master} difficulty or higher and prepare the required build and fireteam.
Complete the entire Ops activity through its final result screen on the selected difficulty.

achievements.description: Complete an Ops Activity on Grandmaster difficulty.
achievements.summary: Complete any Ops activity in the Director's Portal on Grandmaster difficulty.

guide.context: Grandmaster is the highest Portal tier used by this legacy achievement and demands an endgame-ready build. The same clear also awards the Master-or-higher achievement if it is still locked.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Director}, enter the @loc{Portal}, and choose an Ops activity that currently offers @mechanic{Grandmaster} difficulty.
Set Grandmaster, equip a build suited to the displayed modifiers, and form the required fireteam before launching.
Complete every encounter and reach the activity result screen without lowering the selected difficulty.

achievements.description: Encounter an Agent of the Nine somewhere in the system.
achievements.summary: Speak to @npc{Xûr} in the Tower Bazaar between Friday's arrival and Tuesday's weekly reset.

guide.context: Xûr is unavailable from the Tuesday reset until Friday. During his visit, the Tower map displays his vendor marker.

steps.text: Launch Destiny 2 between Friday's Xûr arrival and the Tuesday weekly reset.
Travel to @loc{the Tower Bazaar} and enter the small nook beside the ramen shop, following Xûr's map marker.
Open @npc{Xûr}'s vendor screen while he is present.

achievements.summary: Complete and claim enough Triumph objectives in the Journey menu to raise the account's Triumph score to 5,000.

guide.context: Triumph objectives track across many activities, but completed Triumphs must be claimed before their displayed points are added to the account score.

steps.text: Open @loc{Journey}, select @loc{Triumphs}, and identify currently obtainable objectives with score values.
Finish Triumph objectives across available activities, destinations, and modes until at least 5,000 total points are available.
Claim each completed Triumph in the Journey menu until the displayed account Triumph score reaches 5,000.

achievements.description: Collect 10 Forsaken Exotic weapons or armor.
achievements.estTime: 40–100 hours depending on ownership and drops
achievements.summary: Register 10 distinct @item{Forsaken Exotic weapons or armor pieces} in Collections.

guide.context: Collections records distinct items rather than duplicate drops. Forsaken entries can come from surviving quests, eligible Exotic drops, Xûr, or the Monument to Lost Lights.

steps.text: Open @loc{Collections} and count the Forsaken Exotic weapons and armor entries already registered on the account.
Acquire missing Forsaken Exotics from their available quests, eligible Exotic engrams, @npc{Xûr}, or the @loc{Monument to Lost Lights}.
Continue until Collections records 10 distinct Forsaken Exotic weapon or armor entries.

achievements.estTime: 30–100 hours depending on the chosen seal
achievements.summary: Complete every Triumph in one currently attainable Triumph Seal, then claim its title in the Journey menu.

guide.context: Seals group Triumphs around an activity, destination, event, or season. A seal with vaulted or expired requirements cannot be finished, so confirm every listed Triumph is still obtainable before committing.

steps.text: Open @loc{Journey}, select @loc{Titles}, and choose a Triumph Seal whose complete requirement list is currently available.
Complete and claim every Triumph shown inside that same seal.
Return to the completed seal and claim its title after every requirement is marked complete.

achievements.estTime: 50–150 hours depending on the legacy badge
achievements.summary: Complete every item slot in one Forsaken-era or earlier Collections Badge on a single character, preferably @item{Destinations: Dreaming City}.

guide.context: The platform achievement uses a legacy badge list. Newer badges can complete in-game without awarding credit, while the Dreaming City badge is a known compatible route.

steps.text: Open @loc{Collections}, select @loc{Badges}, and choose the @item{Destinations: Dreaming City} badge or another Forsaken-era-or-earlier badge.
Acquire every weapon, armor piece, emblem, shader, Ghost shell, ship, and Sparrow shown in that badge, including the selected character's class-specific armor slots.
Fill every slot on the same character and reopen the completed badge so the account-wide completion registers.

achievements.summary: Select the @loc{Dreaming City} in the Director and land in its patrol space.

guide.context: This hidden achievement requires destination entry rather than campaign completion or a Dreaming City activity clear.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Director} and select the @loc{Dreaming City} destination.
Choose an available Dreaming City landing zone and launch the patrol destination.
Wait until the Guardian finishes loading into the Dreaming City patrol space.

achievements.description: Complete the Hunters' Remembrance quest and claim Wish-Ender.
achievements.summary: Complete @npc{Petra Venj}'s @mechanic{Hunters' Remembrance} quest in Shattered Throne and claim @item{Wish-Ender} from the pre-boss statue.

guide.context: The quest requires three specific Shattered Throne minibosses rather than a full dungeon clear. The charged mementos are presented before the final boss encounter.

steps.text: Speak to @npc{Petra Venj} in the @loc{Dreaming City}, accept @mechanic{Hunters' Remembrance}, and keep its Awoken Memento on that same character throughout Shattered Throne.
In @loc{Erebus}, carry the blue orb from the Tower of the Deep to the empty-handed statue on the central building's roof, then defeat @enemy{Theratos, Archersbane} and @enemy{Querim, the Waking}.

In @loc{the Descent}, place the Ogre-catwalk orb in the empty right-side statue and carry the Thrallway orb to the empty statue after the railing drop; enter the opened hidden room and defeat @enemy{Eriviks, the Waking}.

During the @enemy{Vorgeth} encounter, extinguish a Petitioner's Burden, kill the camouflaged @enemy{Fleeting Shade} near the exit, place its orb in the side-wall statue, and defeat @enemy{Xavoth, the Waking} before killing Vorgeth.
Defeat Vorgeth, approach @npc{Sjur Eido}'s statue before the final boss, present the three purified mementos, and claim the @item{Wish-Ender} Exotic bow.

achievements.summary: Finish a full Gambit match on the winning team.

guide.context: Only the match result matters for this achievement. Completing a match on the losing team does not award credit.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Director}, select @mechanic{Gambit}, and enter its matchmaking queue.
Complete the match objectives without leaving before the final result.
Defeat the opposing team and remain through the victory result screen.

achievements.description: Complete "The Corrupted" or "Warden of Nothing" on Master difficulty or higher.
achievements.estTime: about 1 hour when an eligible activity is available
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{The Corrupted} or @loc{Warden of Nothing} on Master difficulty or higher.

guide.context: Only the two named activities satisfy this Forsaken-boss counter, and their availability rotates. A different Master activity does not count.

steps.text: Check the current Vanguard or Portal activity selection until @loc{The Corrupted} or @loc{Warden of Nothing} is available.
Select the eligible activity on @mechanic{Master} difficulty or higher and prepare a fireteam for its displayed modifiers.
Complete the full activity and defeat its final boss on the selected difficulty.

achievements.summary: Clear every @loc{Shattered Throne} encounter, including the final battle against @enemy{Dûl Incaru}.

guide.context: Shattered Throne is structured for a three-player fireteam, although it can be entered with fewer players. Completion credit is tied to the final encounter.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Dreaming City} in the Director, select @loc{Shattered Throne}, and launch with the intended fireteam.
Progress through the dungeon's navigation sections and combat encounters until the final arena.
Kill @enemy{Dûl Incaru} and remain in the final arena until the dungeon completion registers.

achievements.estTime: 2–6 hours depending on checkpoint and group
achievements.summary: Complete the @loc{Last Wish} raid by defeating Riven and finishing the Queenswalk encounter.

guide.context: A Riven checkpoint is sufficient for the platform achievement. The raid is designed for six coordinated players, and defeating Riven alone is incomplete until Queenswalk finishes.

steps.text: Form a six-player fireteam and launch @loc{Last Wish} from the @loc{Dreaming City}, using a Riven checkpoint if available.
Complete the Riven encounter and enter the final heart-carrying sequence.
Complete @mechanic{Queenswalk} and remain through the raid-completion result.
